content.title: Goodyear 400 Highlights: Tyler Reddick Wins 4th Race This Season
content.text: After a winless drought of two races, Tyler Reddick is back on top. The No. 45 car won the Goodyear 400 at Darlington Raceway in Darlington, South Carolina, on Sunday, marking his fourth win in six races this season.Reddick actually began Sunday's race in pole position, but fell back late in Stage 1. He was eventually able to regain the lead in the final 30 laps, holding a good edge over the rest of the course by the time the final few laps arrived. Brad Keselowski, who led Sunday's race for 142 laps, finished second. Ryan Blaney came in third. Here's how Sunday's race unfolded: Mar 22, 2026 - 2:30p ET Leaderboard Live Coverage for this has ended Mar 22, 2026 - 6:26p ET Reddick Wins Again Tyler Reddick might have started Sunday's race in pole position, but there were many obstacles he had to drive through in order to win his fourth race this season. Yet, the No. 45 car persisted.Reddick claimed victory at Darlington on Sunday. After leading for roughly half of Stage 1, Reddick was able to climb back into the lead with under 30 laps left. He didn't give up that lead, driving to victory. Mar 22, 2026 - 5:32p ET Keselowski in Trouble at Pit Road Brad Keselowski seemed set to cruise to victory on Sunday, but around Lap 200, he had a bad entry onto Pit Road during a yellow. That allowed Chris Buescher to get in front of him for the lead when the race restarted. Of the cars that went onto pit road, Chase Briscoe passed Keselowski.As for Tyler Reddick, he underwent some more trouble during the caution. His cool suit stopped working on him. Mar 22, 2026 - 4:41p ET Denny Hamlin, Erik Jones Involved in Wreck The first big crash in Sunday's race took place on Lap 111, when Erik Jones, Denny Hamlin and Bubba Wallace were involved in a wreck. Jones and Hamlin got the worst of it, as the yellow flag came out. Mar 22, 2026 - 4:35p ET Blaney Upset at Pit Road Ryan Blaney needed to enter pit road twice in a short span in the middle of Stage 2 because of a loose wheel, leaving him a little uneasy. Mar 22, 2026 - 4:33p ET Reddick's Battery Pushes Him Back Tyler Reddick dealt with a battery issue early in Stage 2 that led to him falling outside the top 10. Mar 22, 2026 - 4:08p ET Brad Keselowski Races to Stage 1 Win Following a slow pit stop for Tyler Reddick, Brad Keselowski jumped in front and never relinquished the lead in Stage 1. He claimed victory in Stage 1 and has led Sunday's race for 44 of the first 90 laps. Reddick led the other 46 laps in Stage 1. Mar 22, 2026 - 3:46p ET Slow Stop for Reddick Tyler Reddick dealt with a slow stop on pit road just over 50 laps into Sunday's race. That led to Brad Keselowski being able to get a lead of over a few seconds 55 laps in. Mar 22, 2026 - 3:24p ET Darrell Waltrip's Boogity, Boogity, Boogity Gets Us Started Darrell Waltrip joined the FS1 booth for Sunday's race and rang us in with his iconic "boggity, boogity, boggity" saying to start the Goodyear 400.
